mobbin:1e4db417-5727-4669-950b-cfb4f457d.summary: User moves from home Dashboard into Analytics hub, dismisses Welcome, configures Schedule adherence (team member + tolerance), loads variance table, then browses Shift audit, Attendance & absence, Geolocation map, and Diversity & turnover.
steps: Home Dashboard — setup carousel + Needs Attention empty
Analytics hub — category tiles + Shift Pulse 4/5 + classic Pay Comparison
Welcome to Analytics — Analyze / View details / schedule-or-export value props
Schedule adherence — filters + empty “Select value on control to load data”
Team Member picker open with per-person counts
Adherence table — Shift vs Timesheet hours/cost; red Hour Difference
Shift audit — notice-time histogram + detail table
Attendance & absence — No shows / Late / Early KPI % + weekly lines
Geolocation map — clock in/out map + last refreshed timestamp
Diversity & turnover — gender/age/tenure pies + people filters
steal: Welcome copy: download spreadsheet, print PDF, or schedule a report to people who need it (step 2) — scheduled digests.
Tolerance (15 min) control before loading adherence (steps 3–5).
Shift vs Timesheet side-by-side with red Hour/Cost Difference (step 5).
Shift Pulse on hub: 4/5 average + sparkline + recent comment (step 1) — formative score + narrative.
avoid: Sigma-powered “+ Create report” / Make a copy BI catalog (steps 2–9) — clashes with Baseline “no deep report builders in first cut.”
mobbin:1e4db417-5727-4669-950b-cfb4f457d.fit: Steal scheduled delivery + adherence/utilisation comparisons + formative pulse; do not port the embedded BI report library.
